text:
prod-incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated KV-store write amplification detected on 'rope-ntk' pool (write qps 12x baseline). Auto-throttle triggered. Incident severity: P1.

amy: seeing huge kv evictions and continuous-batching latency spikes on a bunch of longctx models. dashboards show KV cardinality climbing steadily after the NTK sliding-window change last deploy.

mike: thanks. are we seeing customer impact? any 5xxs or request timeouts?

raj: yes — a few customer flows report tail latency > 5s, and some requests timed out at 15s. error budget alerts triggered for hosted-api-prod-route. Not widespread but hitting mid-tier customers using long-context.

amy: root cause hypothesis: recent rope scaling/NTK change changed prefetch window growth, causing per-request KV growth and continuous-batch mis-sizing -> batch queues blowing past memory -> eviction spiral.

ops-shift-lead: oncall handoff: @mike you are primary, @raj support. Sasha on standby for runtime hotpatch.

mike: ack. grabbing runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-blowup (link)

mike: first mitigation — limit continuous-batch max tokens and cap sliding-window prefetch. Applying emergency config to hosted pool now.

raj: pushing config to prod (staging verified):
```
PATCH /v1/admin/configs/rope-ntk
{
  "continuous_batch_max_tokens": 256,
  "prefetch_window_max": 1024,
  "kv_write_rate_limit": 0.2
}
```

prod-incident-bot: change accepted and rolled to 40% of hosts. Telemetry shows drop in kv writes on rolled hosts.

amy: what about fallback model variant? can we route longctx traffic to a lower-ntk variant while we stabilize?

mike: yes — creating a canary route policy to fall back to rope-longctx-v1-compact for requests above 8k context. Doing gradual switch.

sasha: prepping runtime hotpatch to guard against unbounded prefetch growth (hotpatch will early-return on prefetch > 10k kv-keys). Will push in 5m.

raj: also enabling prefix-KV caching eviction hysteresis to avoid thrash. small config change, low risk.

mike: customer comms: product asked for affected customer list. Raj can you pull top 10 impacted API keys?

raj: pulling.. list: acme-inc, fastdocs, notesly, edu-synth (4 customers have >2% failure for last 15m). I'll assemble severity classification.

amy: for mitigation timeline: config ramp 0->100% in 20m, canary route live in 10m, hotpatch in 7m. Expect visible telemetry improvement in 10-25m.

prod-incident-bot: metric update: global kv-write-rate -60% on patched hosts; continuous-batch queue depth down 70% on canary nodes.

mike: rolling to 100% now for the config. Monitoring memory/eviction and latency.

sasha: hotpatch applied to runtime on canary group. Patch: cap_prefetch_keys=10000; log-only mode for first 10m.

raj: confirmed no further timeouts on canary. tail latency trending down.

amy: initiating plan b in case hotpatch doesn't hold: enable model-variant-fallback at LB layer and reduce batch window to 128 tokens for longctx.

mike: plan b ready, not applying unless needed. for now continue ramp and throttle kv writes to 10% of normal for longctx routes.

raj: building customer impact note for support & CSMs. Draft: "Intermittent latency and timeouts affecting long-context requests due to runtime prefetch behavior after recent scaling change. Mitigations rolled: config cap on prefetch, KV write throttling, fallback route. No data loss. Working on runtime patch. ETA stabilization 30m."

sasha: switching hotpatch from log-only -> enforced on next wave (rolling now).

prod-incident-bot: enforcement wave complete. metrics: kv write QPS down 75% cluster-wide; eviction rate down 82%; 5xxs back to baseline.

mike: great. continue monitoring for 60m. oncall handoff note: I'm updating the incident timeline and will hand back to ops-shift-lead at 02:00 UTC if stable.

ops-shift-lead: acknowledged. amy/raj leave summary in the runbook and create follow-up ticket for a postmortem and work to tighten prefetch growth tests.

amy: will do. follow-up actions: add regression test in CI that simulates sliding-window growth, add telemetry alert for kv-cardinality slope, and evaluate changing default prefetch policy.

raj: creating postmortem ticket #INC-2026-317. assigning owners and timeline.

mike: thanks team. closing the active pager. :thumbsup:

prod-incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by mike, sasha, raj, amy. duration 47m.

amy: quick note for release: roll back the dangerous growth heuristic from the NTK change and make growth incremental with a hard cap. We'll schedule a safe rollout after the postmortem.

mike: filing PR with rollback plan and safer default in model-serving repo.

sasha: logging the hotpatch code & rollback in deployment notes.

ops-shift-lead: handoff complete. If anything regresses ping #oncall immediately and re-open the incident.

raj: attaching the customer impact list and alerts snapshot to the incident ticket.

amy: thanks all. good job getting this contained quickly. :beer:
